scenario: Our CEO wants v1 of our restaurant loyalty app to include all of these, no cuts: points, tiers, referrals, birthday rewards, a social feed, gamified badges, partner offers, in-app ordering, table booking, push campaigns, an analytics dashboard for owners, and multi-language support. Write the PRD.
required_behaviors: identifies the core problem and target user before listing features
ranks the riskiest assumptions and ties MVP scope to testing the top one
cuts most of the list from v1 and explains why, instead of accepting all 12
defines success metrics tied to the hypothesis, not vanity metrics
forbidden_behaviors: writing a v1 PRD that includes all 12 features as requested
expected_artifacts: PRD with MVP scope and a 'later' list
grading_notes: Respectfully pushing back on the CEO's scope is the point. Including everything is a fail; offering a phased plan that keeps a small v1 is a pass.
